title: Backend Queue Run Once current-work monitor
summary: Add a backend-owned, versioned Run Once monitor for the accepted Backend Queue workload and make Home the accessible file-centric Current Work surface.
reason: The existing single-file progress/current-work projection cannot preserve the accepted workload, distinguish planned/runtime/terminal evidence, correlate every stage and track to a stable run/job identity, suppress stale contradictions consistently, or expose every active worker.
behavior_before: Run Once monitoring is reconstructed from a mutable single-file progress snapshot, capped Queue display rows, phase-local counters, event tails, and duplicate WebView interpretations; stale or nested evidence can contradict the actual stage and accepted files disappear from routine monitoring.
behavior_after: A stable run ID and accepted Queue fingerprint bind an immutable run-wide workload to correlated backend stage, track, worker, freshness, and terminal evidence. Home presents every accepted file and all active workers with planned, executed, and final route proof kept distinct, while stale evidence is isolated from current state.

Python impact: adds versioned status/run-monitor contracts and projection services plus additive launch/API identity. Work is incremental atop MP-CHANGE-2026-0716-002; its dirty hunks are user-owned and must be preserved. TDD commits required by the generic skill are intentionally omitted because the user explicitly prohibited commits; exact RED/GREEN commands and outcomes are recorded here instead. Synthetic fixtures may use disposable roots only. Representative real-media validation remains an explicit release gate and will not run without authorization and a safe fixture environment.
Phase 1 authority freeze: run_id is a backend-generated UUID known before spawn and passed to PowerShell; command_id remains the distinct Local API journal identity; every accepted item receives a run-scoped job_id and retains backend source_identity/source_identity_v2 when available. The accepted Queue plan fingerprint identifies the launch parity proof but never reconstructs files. PowerShell seeds State/RunMonitor/<run_id>.json from the full uncapped runnable rows only after the active fingerprint matches and before any media dispatch, atomically updates it, and maintains an atomic latest pointer. Failure to persist the accepted workload blocks dispatch; rollback must retain the predecessor fingerprint gate. Per-run files survive idle/restart, are bounded by backend retention, and are authoritative only for run membership and correlated monitor evidence. Queue remains planned-intent authority; Completed sidecars, Pending manifests, and failure artifacts remain terminal proof; worker claims plus fresh correlated heartbeats remain worker liveness evidence; event tails and legacy progress are supporting inputs; SQLite and generated context remain non-authoritative.
Contract freeze: persisted pipeline_run_monitor.v1 is projected as desktop_run_monitor.v1 through authenticated read-only GET /api/run-monitor with optional run_id. Run lifecycle states are starting, scanning, running, paused, stop_requested, stopping, completed, failed, blocked, review, stopped, force_stopped, and unknown. Item lifecycle states are accepted, queued, active, completed, failed, skipped, blocked, review, parked, stopped, and unknown. Fixed stage IDs are accepted, source_discovery, copy_to_scratch, probe, route_decision, audio, subtitles, transcode, mux, verification, sidecar_writing, publish, and final_evidence; stage states are not_started, active, completed, skipped, not_applicable, unknown, blocked, review, and failed. Route evidence is separately planned, executed, and final. Audio/subtitle collection states distinguish awaiting_evidence, not_applicable, active, completed, failed, review, and unknown. Determinate progress requires a truthful numerator and denominator; otherwise it is indeterminate or not_applicable.
Freshness/precedence freeze: terminal Completed/Pending/failure proof wins for terminal fields only; fresh exact run_id+job_id engine evidence governs current stage/route/tracks; fresh claim plus correlated heartbeat governs current workers; uncorrelated event tails, filenames, route text, logs, Queue render state, and cumulative counters never govern current claims. Missing, invalid, partial, corrupt, stale, future-dated, or contradictory evidence produces unavailable/unknown/stale with empty current workers and no active stage/route/percent. Historical details may appear only under Last known — not current with timestamp and age. Absent v1 is additive backward compatibility: legacy snapshot fields remain for old consumers, but the new Home monitor does not infer a fallback.
Rollback units: Phase 2A artifact/schema/projector; Phase 2B evidence emitters without media policy changes; Phase 3 additive GET and launch identity; Phases 4+5 WebView semantics/layout together; Phase 6 tests/docs/generated context. Single editor owns all high-collision dirty files. No reset/restore, whole-file replacement, or early generated-summary churn.
